id.description: Chat instance ID for action menus.

senderId.description: ID of the sender in participants.

text.description: Message text. Chat safely renders **bold**, *italic*, <u>underline</u>, ~~strike~~, numbered and bulleted lines, > quotes, and fenced code blocks. Use content for other rich content.

content.description: Optional rich message content. Sanitize HTML before passing it to Django; supply exportText for copied transcripts.

exportText.description: Plain text or Markdown used by Copy conversation for rich messages.

sentAt.description: ISO calendar timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss[.fraction]], optionally followed by Z or ±HH:mm). Grouping treats a missing timezone as UTC and truncates fractions to milliseconds; invalid dates remain ungrouped. Rendered datetime attributes and timeLabel strings are unchanged.

timeLabel.description: Localized timestamp label. Visible on the last message in a close group; retained for screen readers on earlier messages.

groupPosition.description: Optional explicit grouping position. Both renderers derive it from adjacent sender IDs and sentAt values when omitted.

attachments.description: Files and images included with the message.

imageUrl.description: Optional image preview URL rendered through Image.

alt.description: Description of the preview image. Defaults to the file name.

replies.description: Messages displayed in this message's thread.

olderReplies.description: Optional older-page state for this message's thread, using the same fields as olderHistory.

replyCount.description: Visible count of replies to this message; a positive count adds a persistent thread link beside message metadata.

layout.description: Use panel for host-supplied editing or confirmation content. It expands to the available row width and uses a neutral surface instead of the sender's bubble color.

deliveryStatus.description: Delivery or read status supplied by the application.

actions.description: Overflow menu items, such as Edit or Delete. The application handles the action.

reactions.description: Current reactions, rendered as toggle buttons in supplied order. Keep an entry in place while its count remains positive.

label.description: Accessible reaction name and event value.

selected.description: Whether the current user selected this reaction.

reactionOptions.description: Emoji choices for adding a reaction to this message; overrides the Chat-level list. An empty array disables new reactions.

label.description: Accessible choice name and event value.

clientMessageId.description: Host-supplied correlation ID for a submitted message.

deliveryState.description: Host-supplied sending or failed state. Failed messages expose a Retry control that emits usx:chat-retry.

name.description: Visible sender name and transcript label.

avatarProps.description: Avatar props. Chat renders avatars without links.

presence.description: Optional current presence in inbox and contact lists. The host must keep it current; it is not a response-time promise.

showCopyMessageAction.description: Show Copy message in each message's More menu when the message has exportable content.

reactionOptions.description: Emoji choices in each message’s Add reaction Popover. Defaults to emojiPack. Pass an empty array to disable adding reactions.

label.description: Accessible choice name and event value.

name.description: Optional shortcode name; used for the reaction menu tooltip.

allowThreads.description: Whether the containing conversation enables threads. Thread views do not offer nested threads.
